_comments.purpose: Project-local OpenCode config that registers the chimera-team MCP server so OpenCode sessions can participate in a Chimera agent team.
_comments.auth: OpenCode requires `opencode auth login` (or an OPENCODE_API_KEY in env) before MCP tools are visible. Without auth the agent stays in unauthenticated mode and the team_* tools won't be invoked.
_comments.path_layout: All team state lives under CHIMERA_TEAMS_HOME (defaults to ~/.chimera/teams). The MCP server creates {{TEAMS_HOME}}/<team-name>/{config.json, task_list.jsonl, mailbox/*.jsonl}. Replace {{TEAMS_HOME}} below with an absolute path you control (e.g. /Users/you/.chimera/teams) — OpenCode does not expand ~.
_comments.identity: CHIMERA_TEAM and CHIMERA_AGENT identify this OpenCode instance to the team. Change them per project / per session as needed. The MCP server falls back to these env vars when --team / --agent flags are absent.
_comments.experimental_flag: CHIMERA_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 is required — the server refuses to start without it.
_comments.sandbox_note: Unlike Codex, OpenCode does not impose a read-only filesystem sandbox on its MCP children by default, so no extra --add-dir flag is needed. Just ensure the user running OpenCode has write access to {{TEAMS_HOME}}.
